q.id: Manakah yang merupakan tujuan umum testing?
q.en: Which is a typical test objective?

id: Memperbaiki defect yang ditemukan di kode setelah testing dinamis selesai dijalankan
Mengevaluasi work product seperti requirement dan desain
Men-deploy aplikasi ke produksi setelah semua test otomatis dinyatakan lolos
Menulis kode untuk fitur baru berdasarkan hasil analisis requirement oleh tim
en: Fixing the defects found in the code after dynamic testing has been run
Evaluating work products such as requirements and design
Deploying the application to production once all automated tests are declared passed
Writing code for a new feature based on the team's requirement analysis results

exp.id: Mengevaluasi work product termasuk tujuan testing. Memperbaiki defect adalah debugging (developer), deploy dan menulis kode bukan tujuan testing.
exp.en: Evaluating work products is a test objective. Fixing defects is debugging (developers); deploying and writing code are not test objectives.

q.id: Pernyataan mana yang membedakan testing dan debugging dengan benar?
q.en: Which statement correctly distinguishes testing from debugging?

id: Testing memperbaiki defect, sedangkan debugging menemukan failure pada saat sistem berjalan
Testing memicu failure akibat defect; debugging menemukan dan memperbaiki penyebabnya
Keduanya sama-sama selalu dilakukan oleh tester karena tujuan dan hasilnya identik
Debugging hanya dilakukan setelah rilis, ketika pengguna sudah melaporkan masalah di produksi
en: Testing fixes defects, while debugging finds failures while the system is running
Testing triggers failures caused by defects; debugging finds and fixes their causes
Both are always done by testers because their purpose and results are identical
Debugging is only done after release, once users have reported problems in production

exp.id: Testing menampakkan failure; debugging (oleh developer) menelusuri dan memperbaiki penyebab. Confirmation testing lalu memastikan perbaikannya berhasil.
exp.en: Testing exposes failures; debugging (by developers) traces and fixes causes. Confirmation testing then checks the fix.

q.id: Bagaimana testing berkontribusi pada kesuksesan proyek?
q.en: How does testing contribute to project success?

id: Menjamin sistem bebas defect sehingga tidak ada failure yang akan terjadi di produksi
Mengurangi risiko failure saat beroperasi dengan menemukan defect lebih dulu
Menghilangkan kebutuhan review karena semua masalah pasti ditemukan oleh pengujian
Menggantikan requirement karena test case sudah menjelaskan perilaku yang diharapkan
en: Guarantees the system is defect-free so no failure will occur in production
Reduces the risk of failures in operation by finding defects beforehand
Removes the need for reviews because testing is certain to find every problem
Replaces requirements because the test cases already describe the expected behaviour

exp.id: Testing tidak bisa menjamin bebas defect (prinsip 1). Kontribusinya adalah mengurangi risiko dan meningkatkan kualitas.
exp.en: Testing cannot guarantee zero defects (principle 1). Its contribution is reducing risk and improving quality.

q.id: Testing merupakan contoh dari...
q.en: Testing is an example of...

exp.id: Testing adalah bentuk quality control (berorientasi produk). QA berorientasi proses dan pencegahan.
exp.en: Testing is a form of quality control (product-oriented). QA is process-oriented and preventive.

q.id: Total di invoice tampil salah. Penyelidikan: rumus di kode salah karena developer salah membaca requirement yang ambigu. Mana yang merupakan FAILURE?
q.en: An invoice shows a wrong total. Investigation: the code formula is wrong because the developer misread an ambiguous requirement. Which is the FAILURE?

id: Total yang salah yang terlihat oleh user
en: The wrong formula in the code
The wrong total the user sees

exp.id: Failure = perilaku salah saat dijalankan (total salah). Rumus salah = defect, salah baca = error, requirement ambigu = root cause.
exp.en: Failure = wrong behaviour at run time (the wrong total). Wrong formula = defect, misreading = error, ambiguous requirement = root cause.

q.id: Tim menguji sistem kendali penerbangan jauh lebih ketat daripada situs pemasaran. Prinsip apa yang tercermin?
q.en: A team tests an airline control system far more rigorously than a marketing site. Which principle is reflected?

id: Early testing saves time and money
en: Early testing saves time and money

exp.id: Pendekatan testing bergantung pada konteks dan risiko; sistem kritis keselamatan butuh usaha lebih besar.
exp.en: The test approach depends on context and risk; safety-critical systems need more effort.

q.id: Menguji semua kombinasi input dan precondition tidak mungkin kecuali kasus sepele, sehingga dipakai analisis risiko dan prioritas. Prinsip apa ini?
q.en: Testing all combinations of inputs and preconditions is impossible except for trivial cases, so risk analysis and priorities are used. Which principle is this?

id: Testing shows the presence of defects
en: Testing shows the presence of defects

exp.id: Itulah prinsip exhaustive testing is impossible; solusinya memilih tes lewat teknik dan risiko.
exp.en: That is the exhaustive-testing-is-impossible principle; the answer is choosing tests via techniques and risk.

q.id: Aktivitas test mana yang menjawab pertanyaan "APA yang perlu diuji" dengan mengidentifikasi test condition?
q.en: Which test activity answers "WHAT to test" by identifying test conditions?

exp.id: Test analysis menentukan apa yang diuji (test condition); test design menentukan bagaimana mengujinya (test case).
exp.en: Test analysis decides what to test (test conditions); test design decides how (test cases).

q.id: Testware mana yang umumnya dihasilkan pada test implementation?
q.en: Which testware is typically produced during test implementation?

exp.id: Implementation menghasilkan test procedure, test suite, data, dan jadwal eksekusi. Completion report dari test completion, plan dari planning.
exp.en: Implementation produces test procedures, suites, data and an execution schedule. Completion report comes from test completion; plan from planning.

q.id: Manfaat traceability antara requirement dan test case adalah...
q.en: A benefit of traceability between requirements and test cases is...

id: Menjamin semua test case selalu otomatis sehingga eksekusi tidak butuh tenaga manusia
Menilai coverage requirement oleh tes dan menganalisis dampak perubahan
Menghilangkan perlunya test plan karena semua hubungan sudah tercatat dalam matriks
Mempercepat eksekusi tes dengan menjalankan hanya test yang terhubung ke requirement baru
en: Guarantees all test cases are always automated so execution needs no human effort
Assessing requirement coverage by tests and analysing the impact of changes
Removes the need for a test plan because every relationship is already recorded in the matrix
Speeds up test execution by running only the tests linked to the new requirements

exp.id: Traceability mendukung evaluasi coverage, impact analysis, dan audit.
exp.en: Traceability supports coverage evaluation, impact analysis and audits.

q.id: Tugas mana yang termasuk peran test management?
q.en: Which task belongs to the test management role?

id: Mendesain test case berdasarkan kondisi test yang sudah dianalisis
Menjalankan test case dan membandingkan hasil aktual dengan hasil yang diharapkan
Memantau kemajuan dan mengontrol aktivitas test
Menyiapkan data tes dan lingkungan yang dibutuhkan untuk eksekusi
en: Designing test cases from the test conditions that were analysed
Executing test cases and comparing actual results with expected results
Monitoring progress and controlling test activities
Preparing test data and the environment needed for execution

exp.id: Test management: planning, monitoring, control, completion. Analysis, design, implementation, execution adalah peran testing.
exp.en: Test management: planning, monitoring, control, completion. Analysis, design, implementation, execution are the testing role.

q.id: Kekurangan potensial dari tester yang independen adalah...
q.en: A potential drawback of independent testers is...

id: Mereka menemukan jenis defect yang sama persis dengan yang ditemukan developer
Mereka bisa terisolasi dari tim dan developer merasa kualitas bukan tanggung jawabnya
Mereka sama sekali tidak bisa menulis test case karena tidak memahami kode aplikasi
Mereka selalu bias terhadap hasil kerja developer sehingga laporannya tidak bisa dipercaya
en: They find exactly the same kinds of defects as developers do
They may become isolated from the team, and developers may feel quality is not their job
They cannot write test cases at all because they do not understand the application code
They are always biased against the developers' work so their reports cannot be trusted

exp.id: Independensi memberi pandangan segar tetapi berisiko isolasi dan berkurangnya rasa tanggung jawab developer.
exp.en: Independence gives a fresh view but risks isolation and reduced developer ownership.

q.id: Whole-team approach berarti...
q.en: The whole-team approach means...

id: Hanya tester yang bertanggung jawab atas kualitas, sedangkan anggota tim lain fokus pada fitur
Siapa pun dengan keahlian yang dibutuhkan bisa mengerjakan tugas; seluruh tim bertanggung jawab atas kualitas
Semua orang di tim harus menjadi tester bersertifikat sebelum boleh ikut mengerjakan tugas
Developer dilarang menguji agar pekerjaan pengujian tetap independen dari pengembangan
en: Only testers are responsible for quality, while other team members focus on features
Anyone with the needed skills can do the tasks; the whole team is responsible for quality
Everyone on the team must be a certified tester before taking part in any tasks
Developers are forbidden from testing so that testing stays independent of development

exp.id: Kualitas adalah tanggung jawab bersama, memanfaatkan keahlian seluruh tim.
exp.en: Quality is a shared responsibility using the skills of the whole team.

q.id: Keterampilan umum mana yang penting bagi tester?
q.en: Which generic skill is important for a tester?

id: Menyampaikan defect secara konstruktif kepada developer

exp.id: Komunikasi yang baik, ketelitian, pemikiran kritis, dan pengetahuan domain adalah keterampilan umum tester.
exp.en: Good communication, thoroughness, critical thinking and domain knowledge are generic tester skills.

q.id: Dibandingkan model sekuensial, testing pada proyek Agile umumnya...
q.en: Compared with a sequential model, testing in an Agile project is generally...

id: Dilakukan hanya setelah semua coding selesai
Dilakukan di setiap iterasi berdampingan dengan pengembangan
en: Done only after all coding is finished
Done in every iteration alongside development

exp.id: Model iteratif menguji di tiap iterasi; regression test justru semakin penting karena perubahan sering.
exp.en: Iterative models test in each iteration; regression testing matters even more because change is frequent.

q.id: Praktik testing yang baik di SDLC apa pun adalah...
q.en: A good testing practice in any SDLC is...

id: Setiap aktivitas pengembangan punya aktivitas test yang sepadan
Satu test level cukup untuk semua tujuan
en: Each development activity has a corresponding test activity
One test level is enough for every objective
Testers do not take part in requirement discussions

exp.id: Itu praktik pertama; juga setiap test level punya tujuan khusus dan tester ikut mengulas requirement.
exp.en: That is the first practice; also each test level has specific objectives and testers join requirement reviews.

q.id: Pendekatan mana yang menulis perilaku dengan format Given/When/Then yang dipahami stakeholder bisnis?
q.en: Which approach expresses behaviour in Given/When/Then format understandable to business stakeholders?

exp.id: BDD memakai bahasa alami Given/When/Then. TDD memakai tes unit yang ditulis lebih dulu.
exp.en: BDD uses natural-language Given/When/Then. TDD uses unit tests written first.

q.id: Manfaat DevOps bagi testing adalah...
q.en: A benefit of DevOps for testing is...

id: Menghilangkan semua manual testing karena pipeline menjalankan semua jenis pengujian
Umpan balik kualitas cepat lewat pipeline CI/CD yang menjalankan tes otomatis
Tidak perlu lagi merawat otomasi karena pipeline memperbaiki test yang rusak sendiri
Test environment tidak lagi dibutuhkan karena semua tes berjalan di mesin developer
en: Removes all manual testing because the pipeline runs every kind of test
Fast quality feedback through CI/CD pipelines that run automated tests
Automation no longer needs maintenance because the pipeline repairs broken tests itself
Test environments are no longer needed because all tests run on developers' machines

exp.id: CI/CD memberi feedback cepat dan mendorong shift-left; manual testing tetap dibutuhkan dan pipeline perlu dirawat.
exp.en: CI/CD gives fast feedback and promotes shift-left; manual testing remains and pipelines need maintenance.

q.id: Contoh shift left yang tepat adalah...
q.en: A correct example of shift left is...

id: Menunda test sampai tahap akhir proyek ketika semua fitur sudah selesai dibuat
Mereview user story dan acceptance criteria sebelum coding dimulai
Menambah jumlah tester setelah rilis agar defect produksi bisa diperbaiki lebih cepat
Menghapus static analysis dari pipeline supaya proses build berjalan lebih singkat
en: Postponing tests to the final phase of the project when every feature is finished
Reviewing user stories and acceptance criteria before coding begins
Adding more testers after release so production defects can be fixed more quickly
Removing static analysis from the pipeline so the build process runs more briefly

exp.id: Shift left = aktivitas test lebih awal; review dini dan TDD adalah contohnya.
exp.en: Shift left = test activities earlier; early reviews and TDD are examples.

q.id: Retrospective umumnya diadakan...
q.en: A retrospective is generally held...

id: Sebelum proyek dimulai untuk menetapkan jadwal dan pembagian tugas seluruh anggota tim
Di akhir proyek atau iterasi untuk membahas keberhasilan dan perbaikan
Hanya ketika produksi gagal total, sebagai bagian dari analisis insiden yang formal
Setiap kuartal untuk menilai kinerja individu dan menentukan kenaikan gaji anggota tim
en: Before the project starts to set the schedule and the division of tasks for all team members
At the end of a project or iteration to discuss successes and improvements
Only when production fails completely, as part of a formal incident analysis
Each quarter to evaluate individual performance and decide pay raises for team members

exp.id: Tujuan retrospective adalah perbaikan proses tim, bukan menilai individu.
exp.en: A retrospective is for team process improvement, not for judging individuals.

q.id: Menguji interaksi antara aplikasi web dan layanan pembayaran eksternal termasuk test level...
q.en: Testing the interaction between a web app and an external payment service belongs to the test level...

exp.id: Interaksi antar sistem (termasuk layanan eksternal) = system integration. Component integration hanya antar komponen dalam satu sistem.
exp.en: Interaction between systems (including external services) = system integration. Component integration is between components within one system.

q.id: Pengujian oleh administrator untuk backup/restore dan disaster recovery termasuk...
q.en: Testing by administrators for backup/restore and disaster recovery is...

exp.id: Operational acceptance testing menguji kesiapan operasional: backup, recovery, pemeliharaan, keamanan.
exp.en: Operational acceptance testing checks operational readiness: backup, recovery, maintenance, security.

q.id: Pernyataan mana yang benar tentang white-box testing sebagai test type?
q.en: Which statement about white-box testing as a test type is true?

id: Didasarkan pada struktur internal sistem seperti kode atau arsitektur
Hanya dilakukan pada acceptance level oleh pengguna bisnis sebelum rilis dilakukan
Didasarkan hanya pada spesifikasi tanpa melihat bagaimana sistem dibangun di dalamnya
Tidak mengukur coverage apa pun karena fokusnya hanya pada perilaku dari luar
en: It is based on the internal structure of the system such as code or architecture
It is done only at acceptance level by business users before the release happens
It is based only on the specification, without looking at how the system is built inside
It does not measure any coverage because it focuses only on behaviour seen from outside

exp.id: White-box = berbasis struktur dan dapat dilakukan di semua level; mengukur coverage struktur.
exp.en: White-box = structure-based, applicable at all levels, measuring structural coverage.

q.id: Setelah bug login diperbaiki, tester menjalankan ulang test case yang gagal tadi, lalu menjalankan tes fitur lain untuk memeriksa efek samping. Kedua langkah ini berturut-turut disebut...
q.en: After a login bug is fixed, the tester re-runs the failed test case, then runs tests on other features to check side effects. These two steps are called, in order...

exp.id: Menjalankan ulang tes yang gagal = confirmation; memeriksa efek samping = regression.
exp.en: Re-running the failed test = confirmation; checking side effects = regression.

q.id: Pemindahan aplikasi ke platform atau database baru adalah pemicu maintenance testing berupa...
q.en: Moving an application to a new platform or database is a maintenance testing trigger of type...

exp.id: Pemicu: modification (perubahan fitur/perbaikan), migration (pindah platform/data), retirement (pensiun sistem).
exp.en: Triggers: modification (changes/fixes), migration (platform/data move), retirement (system decommissioning).

q.id: Mana yang dapat diperiksa dengan static testing?
q.en: Which can be examined with static testing?

en: Response time of a running system

exp.id: Static testing memeriksa work product tanpa menjalankannya (kode, requirement). Tiga lainnya butuh eksekusi (dynamic).
exp.en: Static testing examines work products without running them (code, requirements). The other three need execution (dynamic).

q.id: Nilai utama static testing adalah...
q.en: The main value of static testing is...

id: Menemukan defect lebih awal sehingga lebih murah diperbaiki
Menjamin kode bebas bug sebelum masuk ke tahap pengujian dinamis maupun rilis
Menggantikan dynamic testing sepenuhnya sehingga eksekusi kode tidak lagi diperlukan
Mengukur performa aplikasi di bawah beban nyata dengan banyak pengguna sekaligus
en: Finding defects early so they are cheaper to fix
Guaranteeing bug-free code before it enters dynamic testing or release
Replacing dynamic testing completely so executing the code is no longer necessary
Measuring application performance under real load with many users at the same time

exp.id: Static dan dynamic saling melengkapi; static unggul menemukan defect dini.
exp.en: Static and dynamic testing complement each other; static excels at early defects.

q.id: Jenis defect mana yang lebih mudah ditemukan lewat static testing daripada dynamic testing?
q.en: Which defect type is easier to find by static testing than by dynamic testing?

exp.id: Ambiguitas, inkonsistensi, dan pelanggaran standar ditemukan lewat review/analisis; masalah runtime butuh dynamic.
exp.en: Ambiguity, inconsistency and standard violations are found by review/analysis; runtime problems need dynamic testing.

q.id: Manfaat umpan balik awal dan sering dari stakeholder adalah...
q.en: A benefit of early and frequent stakeholder feedback is...

exp.id: Umpan balik dini mengurangi salah paham dan pengerjaan ulang mahal.
exp.en: Early feedback reduces misunderstanding and costly rework.

q.id: Pada aktivitas review mana reviewer membaca work product sendiri dan mencatat temuan?
q.en: In which review activity do reviewers read the work product alone and note findings?

exp.id: Individual review (persiapan individu) mendahului komunikasi dan analisis temuan.
exp.en: Individual review (preparation) precedes communication and analysis of findings.

q.id: Siapa yang mencatat temuan selama rapat review?
q.en: Who records the findings during a review meeting?

exp.id: Scribe mencatat. Author membuat work product, facilitator memimpin, manager menyediakan sumber daya.
exp.en: The scribe records. The author creates the work product, the facilitator leads, the manager provides resources.

q.id: Jenis review mana yang dipimpin author dengan tujuan edukasi dan meminta umpan balik?
q.en: Which review type is led by the author to educate and gather feedback?

exp.id: Walkthrough dipimpin author. Inspection paling formal dengan peran, checklist, dan metrik.
exp.en: A walkthrough is author-led. Inspection is the most formal, with roles, checklists and metrics.

q.id: Faktor sukses review adalah...
q.en: A success factor for reviews is...

id: Hasil review dipakai untuk menilai kinerja author
Peserta punya waktu cukup dan tujuan review jelas
Review dilakukan atas seluruh dokumen sekaligus
en: Review results are used to judge the author's performance
Participants have enough time and the review objectives are clear
The whole document is reviewed at once

exp.id: Tujuan jelas, waktu cukup, potongan kecil, budaya konstruktif. Menilai kinerja author merusak budaya review.
exp.en: Clear objectives, enough time, small chunks, constructive culture. Judging authors damages review culture.

q.id: Pasangan teknik dan kategori mana yang benar?
q.en: Which technique-category pairing is correct?

exp.id: EP dan decision table = black-box; statement testing = white-box; error guessing = experience-based.
exp.en: EP and decision tables = black-box; statement testing = white-box; error guessing = experience-based.

q.id: Tarif tiket ditentukan umur (bilangan bulat): 0-12 anak, 13-64 dewasa, 65-120 lansia. Nilai di luar 0-120 ditolak. Berapa tes minimum untuk 100% equivalence partitioning coverage (valid dan invalid)?
q.en: A ticket fare depends on age (integers): 0-12 child, 13-64 adult, 65-120 senior. Values outside 0-120 are rejected. What is the minimum number of tests for 100% equivalence partitioning coverage (valid and invalid)?

exp.id: Partisi valid: 3 (anak, dewasa, lansia). Invalid: di bawah 0 dan di atas 120 = 2. Total 5 partisi, satu tes per partisi = 5.
exp.en: Valid partitions: 3 (child, adult, senior). Invalid: below 0 and above 120 = 2. Five partitions, one test each = 5.

q.id: Kuantitas valid adalah 1-99. Pasangan nilai mana yang berada di partisi ekuivalen yang SAMA?
q.en: Valid quantity is 1-99. Which pair of values lies in the SAME equivalence partition?

exp.id: 1 dan 99 sama-sama valid. 0 invalid (bawah), 100 invalid (atas); -5 dan 100 berada di dua partisi invalid yang berbeda.
exp.en: 1 and 99 are both valid. 0 is invalid (below), 100 is invalid (above); -5 and 100 are in two different invalid partitions.

q.id: Rentang valid bilangan bulat adalah 10-20. Himpunan nilai tes yang lengkap untuk 3-value boundary value analysis adalah...
q.en: The valid integer range is 10-20. The complete set of test values for 3-value boundary value analysis is...

exp.id: 3-value BVA: tiap batas ditambah kedua tetangganya (9,10,11 dan 19,20,21). Opsi pertama adalah 2-value BVA.
exp.en: 3-value BVA: each boundary plus both neighbours (9,10,11 and 19,20,21). The first option is 2-value BVA.

q.id: Diskon berlaku jika total belanja 100 atau lebih (bilangan bulat, minimal 0). Pasangan nilai mana yang diperlukan untuk 2-value BVA pada batas diskon?
q.en: A discount applies when the order total is 100 or more (integers, minimum 0). Which pair of values is needed for 2-value BVA at the discount boundary?

exp.id: Batas partisi non-diskon/diskon adalah 99 | 100. 2-value BVA memakai batas 100 dan tetangga di partisi sebelah, 99.
exp.en: The non-discount/discount boundary is 99 | 100. 2-value BVA uses boundary 100 and its neighbour in the other partition, 99.

q.id: Aturan diskon: Member dan total >= 100 = 20%; Member dan total < 100 = 10%; Bukan member dan total >= 100 = 5%; Bukan member dan total < 100 = 0%. Hasil yang diharapkan untuk bukan member dengan total 100?
q.en: Discount rules: Member and total >= 100 = 20%; Member and total < 100 = 10%; Non-member and total >= 100 = 5%; Non-member and total < 100 = 0%. Expected result for a non-member with total 100?

exp.id: Total 100 memenuhi >= 100, bukan member, maka rule ketiga: 5%.
exp.en: Total 100 satisfies >= 100 and the user is a non-member, so rule three applies: 5%.

q.id: Sebuah decision table lengkap memiliki 3 kondisi boolean. Berapa jumlah rule-nya?
q.en: A complete decision table has 3 boolean conditions. How many rules does it have?

exp.id: Jumlah rule = 2^n = 2^3 = 8.
exp.en: Number of rules = 2^n = 2^3 = 8.

q.id: Mesin penjual: Idle --(masukkan koin)--> Ready --(pilih)--> Dispensing --(selesai)--> Idle; Ready --(refund)--> Idle. Tes mana yang menguji transisi TIDAK VALID?
q.en: Vending machine: Idle --(insert coin)--> Ready --(select)--> Dispensing --(done)--> Idle; Ready --(refund)--> Idle. Which test exercises an INVALID transition?

id: Memasukkan koin saat mesin sedang Idle dan belum ada produk yang dipilih
Memilih produk saat mesin berada pada state Ready setelah koin dimasukkan
Meminta refund saat mesin Ready setelah koin dimasukkan tetapi belum ada produk dipilih
en: Inserting a coin while the machine is Idle and no product has been selected yet
Selecting a product while the machine is in the Ready state after a coin was inserted
Selecting a product while the machine is Idle
Requesting a refund while Ready after a coin was inserted but no product was selected

exp.id: Event 'pilih' hanya valid di state Ready. Memilih saat Idle tidak ada di model, sehingga merupakan transisi tidak valid.
exp.en: The 'select' event is only valid in the Ready state. Selecting while Idle is not in the model, so it is an invalid transition.

q.id: Program punya 4 statement: S1 baca a; S2 jika a>0; S3 cetak 'pos' (cabang true); S4 cetak 'neg' (cabang false). Satu tes a=5 menghasilkan statement coverage...
q.en: A program has 4 statements: S1 read a; S2 if a>0; S3 print 'pos' (true branch); S4 print 'neg' (false branch). One test a=5 gives statement coverage of...

exp.id: a=5 menjalankan S1, S2, S3 = 3 dari 4 statement = 75%.
exp.en: a=5 executes S1, S2, S3 = 3 of 4 statements = 75%.

q.id: Pada program yang sama (satu keputusan if a>0), satu tes a=5 menghasilkan branch coverage...
q.en: For the same program (one decision if a>0), a single test a=5 gives branch coverage of...

exp.id: Keputusan punya 2 cabang (true dan false). a=5 hanya menjalankan cabang true = 1 dari 2 = 50%.
exp.en: The decision has 2 outcomes (true and false). a=5 covers only true = 1 of 2 = 50%.

q.id: Kekuatan utama white-box testing adalah...
q.en: A key strength of white-box testing is...

id: Menemukan fungsi yang hilang dari kode tetapi sudah ada di spesifikasi dengan jelas
Mempertimbangkan seluruh implementasi sehingga defect bisa ditemukan meski spesifikasi kabur
Tidak memerlukan akses ke kode maupun pengetahuan tentang struktur internal sistem
Selalu menggantikan black-box testing karena cakupannya pasti lebih lengkap dan murah
en: Finding functionality missing from the code even though it is clearly in the specification
Considering the whole implementation so defects can be found even if the specification is vague
Needing no access to the code or knowledge of the system's internal structure
Always replacing black-box testing because its coverage is certainly more complete and cheaper

exp.id: White-box melihat implementasi, tetapi tidak bisa menemukan fungsi yang tidak ada di kode; itu kekuatan black-box.
exp.en: White-box looks at the implementation but cannot find functionality absent from the code; that is a black-box strength.

q.id: Tester membuat daftar kesalahan yang mungkin (pembagian nol, input kosong) dari pengalaman lalu merancang tes. Teknik apa ini?
q.en: A tester lists likely faults (divide by zero, empty input) from experience and designs tests. Which technique is this?

exp.id: Itu error guessing; versi terstrukturnya disebut fault attack.
exp.en: That is error guessing; the structured version is a fault attack.

q.id: Pernyataan mana yang menggambarkan exploratory testing?
q.en: Which statement describes exploratory testing?

id: Desain dan eksekusi tes dipisah jauh dan didokumentasikan penuh sebelum dijalankan
Desain, eksekusi, dan pembelajaran dilakukan bersamaan, dipandu test charter dan sering dibatasi waktu
Tes hanya dijalankan oleh tool otomatis berdasarkan skrip yang ditulis jauh sebelumnya
Hanya dipakai pada unit level oleh developer yang menulis kode yang sedang diuji
en: Test design and execution are kept far apart and fully documented before being run
Design, execution and learning happen together, guided by a test charter and often time-boxed
Tests are run only by automated tools following scripts written long beforehand
Only used at unit level by the developers who wrote the code being tested

exp.id: Ciri exploratory: simultan, charter, time-boxed, melengkapi tes formal.
exp.en: Exploratory traits: simultaneous activities, charter, time-boxed, complements formal tests.

q.id: Pernyataan mana yang benar tentang checklist-based testing?
q.en: Which statement about checklist-based testing is true?

id: Item checklist harus berisi langkah rinci agar siapa pun dapat menjalankannya persis sama
Item checklist bersifat tingkat tinggi dan checklist perlu diperbarui berkala
Checklist tidak boleh berasal dari data defect karena akan membuat tester menjadi bias
Checklist menggantikan test condition sehingga analisis test tidak diperlukan lagi
en: Checklist items must contain detailed steps so anyone can run them in exactly the same way
Checklist items are high-level and the checklist should be updated regularly
A checklist must not come from defect data because that would make testers biased
A checklist replaces test conditions so test analysis is no longer needed

exp.id: Item tingkat tinggi memberi variasi eksekusi; checklist berasal dari pengalaman dan data defect dan dirawat.
exp.en: High-level items allow variation; checklists come from experience and defect data and are maintained.

q.id: Dalam konsep 3 C pada user story, "Confirmation" mengacu pada...
q.en: In the 3 Cs of a user story, "Confirmation" refers to...

en: The story summary on the card
The discussion between developers and the business

exp.id: Card = ringkasan, Conversation = diskusi, Confirmation = acceptance criteria dan tes.
exp.en: Card = summary, Conversation = discussion, Confirmation = acceptance criteria and tests.

q.id: Format acceptance criteria yang tergolong scenario-oriented adalah...
q.en: Which acceptance criteria format is scenario-oriented?

exp.id: Given/When/Then = scenario-oriented; daftar atau tabel aturan = rule-oriented.
exp.en: Given/When/Then = scenario-oriented; bullet lists or rule tables = rule-oriented.

q.id: Story: "Sebagai pelanggan, saya ingin ongkir gratis untuk pesanan minimal $50." Test case acceptance mana yang diturunkan dengan benar?
q.en: Story: "As a customer I want free shipping for orders of at least $50." Which acceptance test case is derived correctly?

exp.id: Pesanan tepat $50 memenuhi kriteria 'minimal $50' sehingga ongkir $0. $49.99 seharusnya berbayar.
exp.en: An order of exactly $50 meets 'at least $50' so shipping is $0. $49.99 should be charged.

q.id: Mana yang umumnya ada di dalam test plan?
q.en: What is typically included in a test plan?

en: Execution results of each test case

exp.id: Test plan memuat konteks, asumsi, risiko, pendekatan, sumber daya, anggaran, dan jadwal.
exp.en: A test plan covers context, assumptions, risks, approach, resources, budget and schedule.

q.id: Kontribusi tester dalam iteration planning adalah...
q.en: A tester's contribution to iteration planning is...

id: Menulis seluruh kode iterasi bersama developer supaya pekerjaan selesai lebih cepat
Membantu membuat user story yang dapat diuji beserta acceptance criteria
Menentukan anggaran proyek dan jumlah anggota tim untuk iterasi yang akan datang
Menghapus semua risiko dari backlog sebelum iterasi dimulai agar tim tenang
en: Writing all the iteration's code together with developers so work finishes sooner
Helping create testable user stories with acceptance criteria
Setting the project budget and the number of team members for the coming iteration
Removing every risk from the backlog before the iteration starts so the team can relax

exp.id: Tester juga membantu analisis risiko dan estimasi usaha testing.
exp.en: Testers also help with risk analysis and test effort estimation.

q.id: Contoh ENTRY criteria yang tepat adalah...
q.en: A suitable example of ENTRY criteria is...

id: Semua defect kritis sudah ditutup dan tidak ada yang tersisa pada daftar defect terbuka
Test environment siap dan data tes tersedia
Coverage target tercapai berdasarkan laporan alat pengukur coverage pada build terakhir
Laporan akhir sudah dikirim kepada seluruh stakeholder yang terlibat dalam proyek ini
en: All critical defects are closed and none remain on the open defect list
The test environment is ready and test data is available
The coverage target is met according to the coverage tool report on the last build
The final report has been sent to all the stakeholders involved in this project

exp.id: Entry criteria adalah prasyarat memulai. Tiga opsi lain adalah exit criteria (syarat selesai).
exp.en: Entry criteria are preconditions to start. The other three are exit criteria (conditions to finish).

q.id: Estimasi three-point untuk sebuah tugas test: optimis 6 hari, paling mungkin 9 hari, pesimis 18 hari. Estimasi E = (a + 4m + b) / 6 adalah...
q.en: A three-point estimate for a test task: optimistic 6 days, most likely 9 days, pessimistic 18 days. The estimate E = (a + 4m + b) / 6 is...

q.id: Tes dan requirement yang dicakup: T1 = R1,R2; T2 = R2; T3 = R3,R4,R5; T4 = R1. Dengan coverage-based prioritization (coverage terbanyak dulu, lalu yang menambah coverage), urutan eksekusi yang benar adalah...
q.en: Tests and the requirements they cover: T1 = R1,R2; T2 = R2; T3 = R3,R4,R5; T4 = R1. With coverage-based prioritization (most coverage first, then additional coverage), the correct execution order is...

exp.id: T3 mencakup 3 requirement terbanyak; lalu T1 menambah R1 dan R2. T2 dan T4 tidak menambah coverage baru sehingga di akhir.
exp.en: T3 covers the most (3 requirements); then T1 adds R1 and R2. T2 and T4 add no new coverage so they go last.

q.id: Pada test pyramid, tes di lapisan atas (UI/end-to-end) umumnya...
q.en: In the test pyramid, tests at the top layers (UI/end-to-end) are generally...

id: Sedikit, lebih lambat, dan lebih mahal

exp.id: Semakin ke atas, cakupan lebih luas tetapi tes lebih sedikit, lambat, dan rapuh.
exp.en: Higher up, scope is broader but tests should be fewer, slower and more brittle.

q.id: Tes mana yang berada di kuadran Q4 (technology-facing, mengkritik produk)?
q.en: Which tests belong to quadrant Q4 (technology-facing, critiquing the product)?

exp.id: Q1 component/integration; Q2 fungsional; Q3 exploratory/usability/UAT; Q4 performa dan keamanan.
exp.en: Q1 component/integration; Q2 functional; Q3 exploratory/usability/UAT; Q4 performance and security.

q.id: Tingkat risiko ditentukan oleh...
q.en: The risk level is determined by...

exp.id: Risk level = kombinasi kemungkinan terjadi dan dampaknya.
exp.en: Risk level = combination of probability of occurring and its impact.

q.id: Mana yang merupakan PROJECT risk?
q.en: Which is a PROJECT risk?

en: The test environment is delivered late
The login feature is easily compromised

exp.id: Project risk menyangkut jalannya proyek (jadwal, sumber daya, lingkungan). Tiga opsi lain adalah product risk.
exp.en: Project risks concern how the project runs (schedule, resources, environment). The other three are product risks.

q.id: Hasil analisis risiko produk dipakai untuk...
q.en: Product risk analysis results are used to...

id: Menentukan cakupan, teknik, dan usaha testing serta prioritas tes
Menggantikan semua test case dengan satu dokumen ringkasan yang disetujui manajer
Menghapus test plan lama setelah setiap iterasi supaya tidak membingungkan tim
Menentukan gaji dan jenjang karier tester berdasarkan jumlah defect yang ditemukan
en: Decide test scope, techniques and effort, and prioritise tests
Replace all test cases with one summary document approved by the manager
Delete the old test plan after each iteration so it does not confuse the team
Decide testers' salaries and career levels based on the number of defects found

exp.id: Risiko tinggi mendapat testing lebih mendalam dan lebih awal.
exp.en: Higher risks get deeper and earlier testing.

q.id: Mana yang merupakan metrik kemajuan test (test progress)?
q.en: Which is a test progress metric?

id: Persentase test case yang sudah dijalankan atau lulus dari yang direncanakan
Jumlah baris kode yang ditulis developer pada iterasi yang sedang berjalan
Total gaji tim yang terlibat dalam proyek selama satu kuartal penuh
Jumlah karyawan di perusahaan pada saat dilakukannya testing berlangsung
en: Percentage of planned test cases executed or passed
Lines of code written by developers in the current iteration
Total salaries of the team involved in the project over a full quarter
Number of employees at the company when the testing takes place

exp.id: Test progress mengukur kemajuan eksekusi tes. Defect count adalah metrik defect.
exp.en: Test progress measures execution progress. Defect count is a defect metric.

q.id: Test completion report dibuat...
q.en: A test completion report is created...

id: Setiap hari tanpa pengecualian, termasuk saat testing baru dimulai sedikit
Di akhir proyek, fase, atau iterasi untuk merangkum testing dan penyimpangan dari rencana
Sebelum requirement ditulis, agar tim tahu apa yang akan dilaporkan nanti
Hanya jika semua tes gagal, sebagai bukti kepada manajemen proyek
en: Every day without exception, even when testing has only just started
At the end of a project, phase or iteration to summarise testing and deviations from plan
Before requirements are written, so the team knows what will be reported later
Only if all tests fail, as evidence for project management

exp.id: Progress report berkala; completion report di akhir dan memuat pembelajaran.
exp.en: Progress reports are periodic; the completion report comes at the end and includes lessons learned.

q.id: Cara umum mengomunikasikan status test pada tim Agile adalah...
q.en: A common way to communicate test status in an Agile team is...

en: Daily stand-up and a task board

exp.id: Pilih kanal sesuai konteks: stand-up, dashboard, task board, atau laporan formal.
exp.en: Choose channels by context: stand-ups, dashboards, task boards or formal reports.

q.id: Bagaimana configuration management mendukung testing?
q.en: How does configuration management support testing?

id: Memastikan item test dan testware teridentifikasi unik, terkontrol versinya, dan saling terhubung
Menggantikan test plan dengan daftar versi build yang disetujui manajemen proyek
Menjalankan ulang seluruh tes otomatis setiap kali ada versi baru dari testware
Menentukan prioritas defect berdasarkan versi yang dilaporkan oleh pengguna
en: Ensuring test items and testware are uniquely identified, version controlled and related
Replacing the test plan with a list of build versions approved by project management
Re-running all automated tests every time a new version of the testware appears
Setting defect priority based on the version reported by users

exp.id: CM menjaga integritas dan traceability testware selama proyek.
exp.en: CM keeps testware integrity and traceability throughout the project.

q.id: Laporan defect mana yang paling baik?
q.en: Which defect report is the best?

id: Pencarian rusak, tolong diperbaiki secepatnya karena sangat mengganggu kami semua
Pencarian 'laptop' di /products: 0 hasil (harapan 12). Build 2.4.1, Chrome 120. Buka /products, ketik, Enter
Developer salah menulis query pencarian, jadi sebaiknya dia memperbaikinya sendiri hari ini
Tolong cek kenapa pencarian tidak jalan, saya sudah mencoba beberapa kali sejak pagi tadi
en: Search is broken, please fix it as soon as possible because it annoys all of us
Searching 'laptop' on /products: 0 results (expected 12). Build 2.4.1, Chrome 120. Open /products, type, Enter
The developer wrote a bad search query, so they should fix it themselves today
Please check why search does not work, I have tried several times since this morning

exp.id: Laporan baik memuat langkah reproduksi, expected vs actual, dan lingkungan. Opsi lain samar atau menyalahkan orang.
exp.en: A good report has steps to reproduce, expected vs actual, and environment. The others are vague or blame people.

q.id: Tool yang mendukung manajemen test case, pelacakan requirement, dan pelaporan tergolong...
q.en: A tool supporting test case management, requirement tracking and reporting is classified as...

exp.id: Tool manajemen test mencakup test case, traceability, dan laporan (mis. TestRail, Zephyr).
exp.en: Test management tools cover test cases, traceability and reports (e.g. TestRail, Zephyr).

q.id: Tool pipeline CI/CD (mis. Jenkins, GitHub Actions) termasuk kategori...
q.en: CI/CD pipeline tools (e.g. Jenkins, GitHub Actions) belong to the category...

exp.id: Tool DevOps mendukung build, integrasi, dan deployment otomatis.
exp.en: DevOps tools support automated build, integration and deployment.

q.id: Mana yang merupakan RISIKO otomasi test?
q.en: Which is a RISK of test automation?

id: Eksekusi lebih konsisten karena langkah yang sama dijalankan persis setiap kali
Usaha dan perawatan otomasi yang diremehkan
Hemat waktu pada tes berulang, terutama untuk regression yang dijalankan tiap rilis
Penilaian hasil lebih objektif karena tidak bergantung pada penilaian manusia
en: More consistent execution because the same steps are run exactly every time
Underestimated effort and maintenance of the automation
Time saved on repeated tests, especially regression that runs for every release
More objective assessment of results because it does not depend on human judgement

exp.id: Tiga lainnya adalah manfaat. Risiko lain: ekspektasi tidak realistis dan ketergantungan pada tool.
exp.en: The other three are benefits. Other risks: unrealistic expectations and over-reliance on the tool.

q.id: Mana yang merupakan MANFAAT otomasi test?
q.en: Which is a BENEFIT of test automation?

id: Mengurangi pekerjaan manual berulang dan eksekusi lebih konsisten
en: Less repetitive manual work and more consistent execution
Replacing the need for exploratory testing

exp.id: Otomasi unggul untuk tes berulang; exploratory dan penilaian manusia tetap dibutuhkan.
exp.en: Automation excels at repeated tests; exploratory testing and human judgement are still needed.

q.id: Faktor mana yang memengaruhi test process dalam suatu konteks?
q.en: Which factor influences the test process in a given context?

en: The SDLC model and product risks
Only the number of files in the repository

exp.id: Konteks mencakup model SDLC, test level dan type, risiko, domain bisnis, batasan operasional, kebijakan, dan standar.
exp.en: Context includes the SDLC model, test levels and types, risks, business domain, operational constraints, policies and standards.

q.id: Analisis risiko produk menunjukkan modul pembayaran berisiko tinggi. Respons yang sesuai adalah...
q.en: Product risk analysis shows the payment module is high risk. A suitable response is...

id: Mengurangi testing pada modul itu agar usaha tim beralih ke modul yang lebih aman
Menambah testing, menugaskan tester berpengalaman, dan memakai teknik lebih ketat
Menghapus modul dari test plan karena risikonya sudah diterima oleh manajemen
Menunda semua testing ke akhir proyek ketika modul lain sudah selesai diuji
en: Reduce testing on that module so the team's effort shifts to safer modules
Add more testing, assign experienced testers and use stricter techniques
Remove the module from the test plan because management has already accepted the risk
Postpone all testing to the end of the project when other modules have been tested

exp.id: Risiko tinggi direspons dengan mitigasi: lebih banyak dan lebih ketat testing serta sumber daya yang tepat.
exp.en: High risk is answered with mitigation: more and stricter testing plus the right resources.
